finalText:
Migration's done. Found 12 stragglers still on `db.query`, all in repo and service files under `packages/` — moved each read and update call to `db.execute({ sql, params })`.

I left two things alone on purpose: `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js`, since that's vendored code, and `cache.query`, which is a different, unrelated call. `verify.js` confirms it — every call site moved, and nothing else did.
